title: [Setup] Shared CDK Bridge JSON fixture and example app template
description:
Create the shared CDK Bridge JSON fixture used by all construct examples.

Fixture location: examples/fixtures/bridge.cdk.json

The file maps directly to CDK context keys (each top-level key becomes a separate CDK context entry in ~/.cdk.json). Structure:
{
  "context": { namespace, environment, stage, region, tags },
  "vpc": { vpc_id, vpc_cidr_block, availability_zones, private_subnet_ids, public_subnet_ids, database_subnet_ids },
  "hostedZones": { public_zone_id, public_zone_name, private_zone_id, private_zone_name, certificate_arn, waf_web_acl_arn },
  "kms": { key_arn, key_id, log_key_arn, secrets_key_arn, sns_key_arn },
  "secrets": { slack_token_arn },
  "logs": { bucket_name, bucket_arn, cloudtrail_bucket_name },
  "alarms": { sns_topic_arn },
  "network": { shared_security_group_id }
}

All values are realistic-looking placeholders. Use acme/dev/app as the context labels.

Also create examples/fixtures/README.md explaining what CDK Bridge JSON is and how to use the fixture in local development.
